front: Tu es sur quels réseaux sociaux ?
pronunciation: [tü eh sür kel ray-zoh soh-SYOH]
back: Which social networks are you on?

front: Je l'ai vu passer sur Instagram.
pronunciation: [zhuh lay vü pah-say sür an-stah-GRAM]
back: I saw it on Instagram.
context: 'Voir passer' = to come across something in your feed.

front: Elle a publié une photo de ses vacances.
pronunciation: [el ah pü-blee-YAY ün foh-TOH duh say vah-KAHNS]
back: She posted a photo from her holiday.

front: Tu peux m'envoyer le lien ?
pronunciation: [tü puh mahn-vwah-yay luh LYAN]
back: Can you send me the link?

front: Partage la vidéo dans le groupe !
pronunciation: [par-tahzh lah vee-DAY-oh dahn luh GROOP]
back: Share the video in the group!

front: J'ai liké sa publication.
pronunciation: [zhay lahy-KAY sah pü-blee-kah-SYOHN]
back: I liked her post.
context: 'Liker' is everyday French; officially 'aimer'. 'Une publication' = a post.

front: Il a plus de dix mille abonnés.
pronunciation: [ee lah plü duh dee meel ah-boh-NAY]
back: He has more than ten thousand followers.
context: 'Un abonné' = follower or subscriber. 'S'abonner à' = to follow/subscribe.

front: Abonnez-vous à la chaîne !
pronunciation: [ah-boh-nay-VOO ah lah SHEN]
back: Subscribe to the channel!

front: Je t'envoie un message privé.
pronunciation: [zhuh tahn-vwah an meh-sahzh pree-VAY]
back: I'll send you a private message.

front: Tu as vu mon message ? Tu ne m'as pas répondu.
pronunciation: [tü ah vü mohn meh-SAHZH ? tü nuh mah pah ray-pohn-DÜ]
back: Did you see my message? You didn't reply.

front: Ma batterie est presque à plat.
pronunciation: [mah bah-tuh-REE eh pres-kuh ah PLAH]
back: My battery is almost dead.

front: Je n'ai plus de réseau ici.
pronunciation: [zhuh neh plü duh ray-ZOH ee-SEE]
back: I've got no signal here.

front: La connexion est trop lente pour regarder la vidéo.
pronunciation: [lah koh-nek-syohn eh troh LAHNT poor ruh-gar-day lah vee-day-OH]
back: The connection is too slow to watch the video.

front: Je télécharge l'application.
pronunciation: [zhuh tay-lay-SHARZH lah-plee-kah-SYOHN]
back: I'm downloading the app.

front: J'ai oublié mon mot de passe.
pronunciation: [zhay oo-blee-YAY mohn moh duh PAS]
back: I forgot my password.
context: 'Réinitialiser le mot de passe' = to reset the password.

front: Crée un compte avec ton adresse e-mail.
pronunciation: [kray an KOHNT ah-vek tohn nah-dres ee-MEL]
back: Create an account with your email address.
context: 'Un compte' = account. 'Se connecter' = to log in.

front: Je me suis déconnecté de tous les réseaux pendant les vacances.
pronunciation: [zhuh muh swee day-koh-nek-TAY duh too lay ray-ZOH pahn-dahn lay vah-KAHNS]
back: I logged off all social media during the holidays.
context: 'Se déconnecter' = to log off, also to unplug mentally.

front: Je passe trop de temps sur mon téléphone.
pronunciation: [zhuh pas troh duh tahn sür mohn tay-lay-FUN]
back: I spend too much time on my phone.
context: 'Passer du temps à / sur' = to spend time on.

front: Cette vidéo a fait le buzz.
pronunciation: [set vee-day-OH ah feh luh BUZ]
back: This video went viral.
context: 'Faire le buzz' = to go viral, create buzz.

front: Il ne faut pas croire tout ce qu'on lit sur internet.
pronunciation: [eel nuh foh pah krwahr too suh kohn lee sür an-tehr-NET]
back: You shouldn't believe everything you read on the internet.

front: C'est une fausse information.
pronunciation: [seh tün fohs an-for-mah-SYOHN]
back: That's fake news.
context: Also 'une fake news' or 'une infox' (official French term).

front: Elle fait des stories tous les jours.
pronunciation: [el feh day stoh-REE too lay ZHOOR]
back: She posts stories every day.
context: Many English social media words are used as-is in French.

front: Je regarde des séries en streaming.
pronunciation: [zhuh ruh-gard day say-REE ahn stree-MEENG]
back: I watch series on streaming platforms.
context: 'Une série' = TV series. 'Regarder en replay' = to catch up.

front: Mon frère est accro aux jeux vidéo.
pronunciation: [mohn frehr eh tah-KROH oh zhuh vee-day-OH]
back: My brother is addicted to video games.

front: Tu peux me taguer sur la photo.
pronunciation: [tü puh muh tah-gay sür lah foh-TOH]
back: You can tag me in the photo.

front: Je préfère qu'on ne publie pas de photos des enfants.
pronunciation: [zhuh pray-fehr kohn nuh pü-blee pah duh foh-toh day zahn-FAHN]
back: I'd rather we didn't post photos of the children.

front: On fait un appel vidéo ce soir ?
pronunciation: [ohn feh tan nah-pel vee-day-OH suh SWAHR]
back: Shall we video call tonight?

front: Ton micro est coupé, on ne t'entend pas.
pronunciation: [tohn mee-KROH eh koo-PAY, ohn nuh tahn-tahn PAH]
back: Your mic is muted, we can't hear you.
context: The most repeated sentence of the remote-work era!

front: J'ai mis à jour mon téléphone hier.
pronunciation: [zhay mee ah ZHOOR mohn tay-lay-FUN YEHR]
back: I updated my phone yesterday.
context: 'Mettre à jour' = to update. 'Une mise à jour' = an update.

front: Les commentaires sous cette vidéo sont horribles.
pronunciation: [lay koh-mahn-tehr soo set vee-day-OH sohn toh-REE-bluh]
back: The comments under this video are horrible.

front: Il a été victime de harcèlement en ligne.
pronunciation: [ee la ay-tay veek-teem duh ar-sel-MAHN ahn LEEN]
back: He was a victim of online harassment.
context: 'En ligne' = online. The h of 'harcèlement' is aspirated.

front: Pense à protéger tes données personnelles.
pronunciation: [pahns ah proh-tay-zhay tay doh-nay pehr-soh-NEL]
back: Remember to protect your personal data.
context: 'Les données' = data (plural). Protected in Europe by the GDPR ('le RGPD').

front: Elle est devenue influenceuse.
pronunciation: [el eh duh-vuh-nü an-flü-ahn-SUHZ]
back: She became an influencer.

front: J'ai fait une capture d'écran de la conversation.
pronunciation: [zhay feh tün kap-tür day-KRAHN duh lah kohn-vehr-sah-SYOHN]
back: I took a screenshot of the conversation.

front: Je reçois trop de notifications.
pronunciation: [zhuh ruh-swah troh duh noh-tee-fee-kah-SYOHN]
back: I get too many notifications.
context: 'Recevoir' = to receive: je reçois (ç before o).
